title: Did the binders spell "X A LIE"? | Conformity Gate Part 4

shots.vo: The most famous clue. In the final scene, the friends slide their Dungeons and Dragons binders onto a shelf. Fans claimed the letters spelled three words: X... A... LIE.
shots.prompt: A hand slides plain three-ring binders with hand-written block letters onto a wooden shelf in a dark bedroom, single desk lamp, deep shadows, letters unreadable

shots.vo: Dimension X was a lie. Vecna never really lost. But look closer. On screen, it reads more like X-A-I-L-E. No hidden message.
shots.prompt: Macro shot sliding slowly along the spines of binders on a shelf, a magnifying glass passing over them, shallow focus, letters blurred

shots.vo: So why did people still believe? Because of a number.
shots.prompt: A 20-sided die rolling in slow motion across a green felt table, stopping just before it lands, red rim light

caption: Did the binders really spell "X A LIE"? Fans say yes, the screen says "X AILE". Part 5: the number 7.
